description: Analyzes an audio track to extract complete musical metadata, AI-generated music detection verdict (HUMAN vs AI_GENERATED Suno/Udio), AND transcribe full vocal lyrics using AI. Supports local audio files via 'filePath' (read in binary and uploaded) or remote URLs via 'fileUrl'. Costs 2 studio credits with a Studio API key, or 0.25 USDC with a wallet per track. (Alias for analyze_audio with extractLyrics: true).

filePath.description: Path to a local audio file on disk (.mp3, .wav, .ogg, .flac, .m4a, .aac, .aiff). Use this whenever analyzing a local file, recording, or email attachment saved locally.

fileUrl.description: The direct publicly accessible URL (HTTP/HTTPS or IPFS) of the audio file to analyze.

name: analyze_audio_with_lyrics
